skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze social issues using economic theories and models.
Apply data analysis techniques to evaluate social and economic policies.
Evaluate the impact of social policies on economic growth and development.
Develop independent research skills and the ability to work in groups.
Effectively communicate research findings through presentations.
Analyze and critique social issues and policies from a critical perspective.
Understand and analyze various social issues such as poverty, inequality, education, health, and migration.
Use quantitative methods to model and analyze social and economic issues.
Develop the ability to self-study and research independently.
Work collaboratively in groups to solve problems and present findings.
